title: Bespoke Autonomy: Comma AI Unlocks Hands-Free Driving for Fisker Ocean Owners and Beyond
summary: After Fisker's abrupt collapse left Ocean owners without promised hands-free driving features, Comma AI has emerged with a robust aftermarket solution. Their open-source system, compatible with over 325 vehicle models, provides advanced driver-assistance capabilities using its own independent hardware, bypassing the car's native sensors.
content:
The automotive industry is no stranger to unfulfilled promises, but few recent sagas sting as much as Fisker's dramatic exit, leaving countless Ocean owners with a beautiful but ultimately underdeveloped vehicle. Among the dashed hopes was the promise of advanced driver-assistance features, particularly hands-free driving capabilities.

Yet, in a remarkable twist of fate, an aftermarket company is now delivering what the manufacturer couldn't. Comma AI, a name increasingly familiar to autonomy enthusiasts, has stepped into the void, offering a third-party solution to bring hands-free driving to the Fisker Ocean – and a rapidly growing list of other vehicles.

What makes Comma AI's approach particularly noteworthy is its ingenious independence. Their technology operates entirely with its own hardware suite, meaning it sidesteps the Fisker Ocean's built-in cameras and sensors altogether. This self-contained unit, powered by Comma AI's open-source software, Openpilot, is capable of delivering sophisticated features like adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assistance, and even stop-and-go traffic capabilities, effectively transforming the driving experience.

But the story extends far beyond the plight of Fisker owners. Comma AI proudly boasts that its system is currently compatible with an astounding roster of more than 325 car models from various manufacturers and specific model years. This broad compatibility underscores a burgeoning trend where innovative third-party developers are democratizing advanced driving features, offering a lifeline to owners of vehicles whose manufacturers either lagged in development or, in Fisker's case, simply ceased to exist.
keyTakeaways: Comma AI provides an aftermarket solution for hands-free driving, including for Fisker Ocean owners left without the feature.
The system uses its own independent hardware (cameras/sensors) and open-source software, bypassing the vehicle's native ADAS components.
Comma AI's technology is broadly compatible with over 325 different car models, extending advanced driving features beyond original manufacturer offerings.
author: staff@jalopnik.com (Chris Tsui)
